from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from .renderers import TSVRenderer
from .models import UserActivityAuditLog
from .serializers import ActivityLogSerializer

class UserActivityLogExportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, TSVRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        if request.accepted_renderer.format == 'tsv':
            # TSV export uses un-scoped query parameter org_id
            org_id = request.query_params.get('org_id')
            logs = UserActivityAuditLog.objects.filter(organization_id=org_id) if org_id else UserActivityAuditLog.objects.all()[:1000]
        else:
            logs = UserActivityAuditLog.objects.filter(user=request.user)

        return Response(ActivityLogSerializer(logs, many=True).data)
diagnosis: The activity log view scopes entries to user=request.user when serving JSON, but when the caller negotiates TSV renderer format, it queries by arbitrary org_id or dumps the latest 1,000 logs across all organizations. Any authenticated standard user can exfiltrate other tenants' internal employee activity and security audit trails.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from .renderers import TSVRenderer
from .models import UserActivityAuditLog
from .serializers import ActivityLogSerializer

class UserActivityLogExportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, TSVRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        # Enforce that user can only export logs from their own authorized organization
        org_id = request.query_params.get('org_id')
        if org_id and str(request.user.organization_id) != str(org_id):
            return Response({'error': 'Unauthorized organization log access'}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        logs = UserActivityAuditLog.objects.filter(organization=request.user.organization)
        return Response(ActivityLogSerializer(logs, many=True).data)
